description: Look up camps by camp or organization name when the parent already knows (roughly) what the camp is called. Tolerates misspellings. Returns matching camps ranked by similarity — use get_camp_details on a result for sessions, prices, and availability. For discovery by area, use search_camps instead.

name.description: Camp or organization name (or part of one), e.g. "Steve and Kate's".

name: find_camp_by_name
title: Find a camp by name
